title: Equations of Circles
seo_title: Geometry Equations of Circles Worksheets (TEKS G.12E)
standard_text: G.12E show that the equation of a circle with center at the origin and radius r is x^2 + y^2 = r^2 and determine the equation for the graph of a circle with radius r and center (h, k), (x − h)^2 + (y − k)^2 = r^2
meta_desc: Free Geometry worksheets for Texas TEKS G.12E: write equations of circles, find the center and radius, complete the square and use points and diameters. 100 questions with answers.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • A circle with center (h, k) and radius r: (x − h)2 + (y − k)2 = r2.
  • Center at the origin: x2 + y2 = r2. This comes from the distance formula.
  • To read the center, change the signs inside the parentheses.

Examples

Example

Center (2, −5), radius 4

(x − 2)2 + (y + 5)2

Answer: = 16

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Wrong signs for h and k(x + 3) means h = −3.
Writing r instead of r2The right side is r2.
Adding to only one sideComplete the square on both sides.

faq.a: Show that the equation of a circle with center at the origin and radius r is x<sup>2</sup> + y<sup>2</sup> = r<sup>2</sup> and determine the equation for the graph of a circle with radius r and center (h, k), (x − h)<sup>2</sup> + (y − k)<sup>2</sup> = r<sup>2</sup>.
It comes from the distance formula squared.

faq.q: How do I find the radius from a diameter?
faq.a: Halve the distance between the endpoints.

faq.q: Is a point on the circle?
faq.a: Check whether it makes the equation true.

items.q: Find the center and radius of the circle x² + 4x + y² + 12y = −24.

items.q: A circle has center (6, −2) and passes through (1, 2). Write its equation.
items.e: The radius is the distance from the center to the point: r² = (−5)² + 4² = 41. (x − 6)² + (y + 2)² = 41.
